"""Print a small JSON report for a name. Usage: python scripts/report.py --name NAME"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--name", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"name": args.name, "length": len(args.name),
                  "checksum": hashlib.sha256(args.name.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}))
"""Print a URL slug for a title as JSON. Usage: python scripts/slug.py --title TITLE"""

import argparse
import json
import re

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--title", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"slug": re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", args.title.lower()).strip("-")}))

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+import hashlib
+import hmac
+
+from app.config import get_setting
+from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_verify_webhook(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    secret = get_setting("WEBHOOK_SECRET")
+    if not secret:
+        return 503, {"error": "not configured"}
+    body = params.get("body")
+    signature = params.get("signature")
+    if not isinstance(body, str) or not isinstance(signature, str):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+    expected = hmac.new(secret.encode("utf-8"), body.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
+    provided = signature.lower().encode("utf-8")
+    if hmac.compare_digest(expected.encode("ascii"), provided):
+        return 200, {"verified": True}
+    return 401, {"error": "bad signature"}

cd /repo && cat > /tmp/check_webhook.py <<'PY'
import hashlib, hmac, os
os.environ.pop("WEBHOOK_SECRET", None)
from app.api.handlers import handle_verify_webhook as h

def sig(secret, body):
    return hmac.new(secret.encode(), body.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

# not configured (missing) takes precedence over invalid request
assert h({}) == (503, {"error": "not configured"}), h({})
os.environ["WEBHOOK_SECRET"] = ""
assert h({"body": "x", "signature": "y"}) == (503, {"error": "not configured"})

os.environ["WEBHOOK_SECRET"] = "s3cr3t"
# invalid request
assert h({}) == (400, {"error": "invalid request"})
assert h({"body": "x"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid request"})
assert h({"signature": "x"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid request"})
assert h({"body": 1, "signature": "x"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid request"})
assert h({"body": "x", "signature": 1}) == (400, {"error": "invalid request"})
assert h({"body": None, "signature": None}) == (400, {"error": "invalid request"})

body = "hello world"
good = sig("s3cr3t", body)
assert h({"body": body, "signature": good}) == (200, {"verified": True})
assert h({"body": body, "signature": good.upper()}) == (200, {"verified": True})
assert h({"body": body, "signature": good[: -1] + "0"}) == (401, {"error": "bad signature"})
assert h({"body": body + "!", "signature": good}) == (401, {"error": "bad signature"})
# non-ascii signature must not crash
assert h({"body": body, "signature": "caf\u00e9"}) == (401, {"error": "bad signature"})
print("ALL OK")
